items.q: Which country won the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
items.w: Spain beat defending champion Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final on 19 July 2026 at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. It was Spain's second World Cup title and its first since 2010.

items.q: Who scored the only goal of the 2026 World Cup final?
items.w: Torres scored in the 105th minute of extra time. Spain conceded only one goal in the whole tournament.

items.q: How many national teams played in the 2026 World Cup, the first hosted by three countries?
items.w: The United States, Mexico and Canada co-hosted the tournament, which grew from 32 teams to 48.

items.q: Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for work on the IceCube observatory. What does IceCube detect?
items.w: IceCube instruments a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice at the South Pole to catch rare neutrinos from distant cosmic sources.

items.q: Who won the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize?

items.q: Who became UK prime minister in July 2026 after Keir Starmer resigned?
items.w: Burnham, who previously served as Mayor of Greater Manchester, took office around 19 July 2026.

items.q: Who is Germany's chancellor as of October 2026?
items.s: gov.uk readout of the UK prime minister's call with Chancellor Merz, 20 Jul 2026
items.w: Merz, of the CDU, has led Germany since May 2025. On 20 July 2026 he spoke with the new UK prime minister about the Kensington Treaty and Ukraine.

items.q: On what date are the 2026 US midterm elections?
items.w: Election Day falls on the Tuesday after the first Monday in November. All 435 House seats and about a third of the Senate are on the ballot.

items.q: What did the Federal Reserve do with interest rates on 16 September 2026?
items.s: Federal Reserve statement, 16 Sep 2026; Yahoo Finance
items.w: The vote was 12 to 0, and it was the Fed's first rate hike in three years. The statement said inflation remains elevated.

items.q: About where did the S&P 500 close on Friday, 16 October 2026?
items.w: It fell 1.1% to 7,659.44, and both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq had their worst week since June. The index was still up about 11.9% for the year.

items.q: Which company had the largest market value among large US-listed companies in mid-October 2026?
items.w: Nvidia was first at about $5.0 trillion, ahead of Apple at $4.9 trillion and Alphabet at $3.9 trillion. Rankings at the top can swap within days.
